_notes: Times are seconds on the A-roll, snapped to Whisper word timestamps (words.json). Cuts land on the first frame of the word named in 'cut_on'.
Each B-roll clip is used once at most. The 3 byte-identical duplicates are never used.
Where the real speech timing differs from the addendum's approximate seconds, the word decides, e.g. 'SKILL + TASTE' lands at 32-35s, not 35-39s.

beats.line: Hey guys, so I officially don't make this kind of content,
beats.treatment: Marker hook quote 'I DON'T MAKE THIS KIND OF CONTENT' word by word from 'I' (1.07); dot-globe at 40%.

beats.line: but something provoked me to make this kind of content and that is this chart.
beats.treatment: Punch-in 1.15 on 'provoked'; caption 'provoked me'; flicker on 'chart' (5.64).

beats.line: If you can see this chart, in just a few years we have lost over lakhs of jobs
beats.treatment: Crimson duotone + Ken Burns; red hero 'LAKHS OF JOBS' on 'lost' (8.82) with flash + boom. No numbers added; the clip's made-up stat cards are muted by the grade.

beats.line: and people are not aware of this till now.
beats.treatment: B&W vertical panel over blurred fill; captions 'not aware' / 'till now'.
Depth title 'my name is / YOUR NAME' (bigTitleIn) on 'Speaker' (14.97).

beats.line: and I was working with some of the teams
and I figured out that people are not aware of the things that they are chasing. In our generation students are chasing
beats.treatment: Captions only, with punch-ins on 'figured' (19.53) and 'In' (23.00) so no framing holds longer than about 3.5s.

beats.line: something that is not even going to exist when they are going to reach their destination.
beats.treatment: Crimson duotone; red hero 'WON'T EXIST' on 'exist' (26.43); static burst on 'destination' (28.27) as it dissolves.

beats.line: So your skillset is waste right now, that doesn't mean that you are a waste.
beats.treatment: Punch-in; 'skill set is waste' with red slash; on the second 'waste' (31.56) the slash goes and 'YOU' pops large.

beats.line: If you have a proper skillset with a proper taste, that's what we pay for or other companies pay for.
beats.treatment: B&W; red hero 'SKILL + TASTE' on 'taste' (34.00) + boom; caption 'we pay for' on 'pay' (35.08).

beats.line: So if you want to grow and if you want to be like that, then you can join our WhatsApp here,
beats.treatment: Clean A-roll after the hero title; punch-in at 'So' (37.00) and 'then' (40.03); caption 'join our WhatsApp' + icon pop/pulse on 'WhatsApp' (41.07).

beats.line: and the thing that you go for for your career.
beats.treatment: B&W; callout CAREER on 'for your' (46.29). Only the first 2s of the clip, before its baked-in 'THANK YOU'.

beats.line: And here is my WhatsApp link, even if we are not able to hire you right now, at least we're going to give you
beats.treatment: Lower third with WhatsApp link placeholder + pulsing red JOIN; punch-ins on 'even' (49.00) and 'at' (51.12).

beats.line: a platform in which you can grow, evolve and earn from there.
So put your demos and practices here in my agency and we gonna figure it out,
beats.treatment: B&W; DEMOS folder pops on 'demos' (56.69), PRACTICE on 'practices' (57.31), both fly into AGENCY on 'agency' (58.62).

beats.line: till that time guys, love you, take care and be happy.
beats.treatment: Clean A-roll, punch-in on 'till' (61.00); from 63.5 fade to black, red YOUR NAME wordmark + WhatsApp handle placeholder.

gap_summary: No beat was left without a usable clip, so no reuse, crop-variation or generation fallback was needed. Weakest match: beat 15 ('career' on the upload clip, meaning 3/5), kept because the addendum names that clip for this spot and it reads as 'sending your work somewhere'.
